newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish bonds dip on U.S., mortgage paper in focus.
newsitem.headline: Danish bonds dip on U.S., mortgage paper in focus.

text.p: Danish bond prices opened lower on Friday, hit by U.S. falls with dealers predicting only minor fluctuations in a market focused on mortgage credit bonds.
"We're not sure just how the U.S. market will behave when it opens this afternoon, but we only expect minimal 0.10 point oscillations only on the Danish market," one dealer said.

The benchmark eight percent state bond due 2006 opened down 0.10 point from Thursday's close at 104.30-36. The 10-year yield gap with Germany was unchanged from noon yesterday at 96 basis points while the crown opened at a stronger 3.8665 per mark. --Chris Follett, Copenhagen newsroom, 45-33-969650
